text: Acceptance 4: REST catch-up silently truncates gaps exceeding 30 messages. In-memory ui-t16-sse repro: start with loaded empty conversation 5 and hasMore=false, reconnect after messages 1..31 arrive, answer the limit=30 request with 2..31. Result: IDs 2..31, hasMore=false; message 1 is missing and cannot be paged in. Fetch through the captured replay floor and maintain pagination/recovery until the gap is complete.
